cases.statement: One affected heterozygous female (P30, family F17) in the Japanese national survey.

people.label: P30 (family F17)
people.zygosity_or_genotype: heterozygous (cohort-level statement that all 54 patients were heterozygous)
people.key_phenotypes: onset 11 months; recurrent fever (initial diagnosis fever of unknown origin); intestinal symptoms; erythema; no oral or genital ulcers listed

quotes.quote: | P30 | Fever of unknown origin | + | −/− | + | − | Erythema | − | − |  |

phenotype_specificity.statement: Cohort-level only: the survey enrolled patients whose HA20 diagnosis was confirmed by functional analysis; TNFAIP3 was Sanger-sequenced or tested on an autoinflammatory gene panel. Results for other genes in this person are not reported.

quotes.quote: The diagnosis of HA20 was confirmed via functional analysis of the TNFAIP3 variant.
Genomic DNA was extracted from peripheral blood for sequencing of all exons and exon-intron junctions of *TNFAIP3*.

Regarding recently identified cases, next-generation sequencing of target genes related to autoinflammatory disorders, including *TNFAIP3*, was performed at the Kazusa DNA Laboratory (Kisarazu, Japan).

segregation.statement: Not stated in the text for family F17 (P30 is the only listed member; pedigree figure not interpretable from the text). Cohort-level penetrance figure only.

quotes.quote: Additionally, family analysis revealed that three cases with heterozygous variants were asymptomatic (penetrance: 95.7%).

functional.statement: Minigene splicing assay (construct: TNFAIP3 exons 3-8 in pCAGGS, transfected into HEK293T cells; wild-type minigene as comparator): RT-PCR and sequencing of the c.487-1G>A minigene product showed partial deletion of exon 4 (c.487_532del; p.Asn163ThrfsX). Patient RNA was not tested.

quotes.quote: Additionally, previously uncharacterized splice-site variants in *TNFIAP3* were functionally analyzed using the minigene splicing assay.
Three of these variants (c.487-1G\>A, c.805+1G\>A, and c.986+1G\>T) were introduced into WTex3-8, and the other (c.2088+1G\>A) into WTex7-9.
The direct sequencing of the PCR product from the c.487-1G\>A minigene showed a partial deletion of exon 4 (c.487_532del; p.Asn163ThrfsX) (**Supplementary Figure 4B**)

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Canonical splice-acceptor change at intron 3 / exon 4 boundary (c.487-1G>A); predicted protein p.? in the batch. Disease mechanism as stated in the papers: heterozygous loss of function (haploinsufficiency).

quotes.quote: A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20) is a hereditary autoinflammatory disease caused by heterozygous loss-of-function variants in the TNFAIP3 gene (1).

authors_classification.statement: Cohort-level only: the authors describe all 35 distinct variants in the 54 surveyed patients with the words quoted. No per-variant ACMG criteria are stated.

quotes.quote: All 54 patients analyzed had heterozygous variants in TNFAIP3, comprising a total of 35 distinct pathogenic variants.

concerns: protein_check differs: the paper's protein p.Asn163ThrfsX38 (pedigree) / p.Asn163ThrfsX (minigene) is the consequence observed in the minigene assay (c.487_532del), not a prediction from the cDNA; the batch predicts p.?.

The variant appears in a survey supplementary table without a case narrative; P30 is cited to reference 19 (Uchida et al. 2020, targeted sequencing in early-onset refractory diarrhea), which is not in the batch.
No transcript is named in the paper.
notes_for_panel: Single affected carrier; the main variant-level evidence is the minigene result (exon 4 partial deletion).
